summary: My project deep-dived into the statistics of the most adventurous lunar rovers on Mars and The moon and created an insight as to how they contributed to the research of the Moon.
details: The presentation uncovers how each lost rover contributed to NASA and its expeditions to the moon using simple data and history. The benefits are to understand the impact of the rovers that we abandoned on the Moon’s surface. The intended impact is to share the word of what our rovers did for science, whether it was to leave a mark, take panoramic photos, or collecting soil for studying. I used Canva for my presentation. My project is creative as I used elements to transform the photo into an environment to blend the photo with the canvas. My team considered in what ways gives the biggest impact and how that impact relates to how it can contribute to the rovers left on Mars and The Moon.
